conbody.p: With the vehicle is in DRIVE READY, select SettingsVehicleDriver assistanceParking safetyRear cross-traffic safety on the infotainment system screen to turn on Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist.

note.p: When the vehicle is restarted, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist will always turn on. However, if Rear cross-traffic safety is deselected after the vehicle is restarted, the driver cannot get help from Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist. Always drive with care.

When the trailer’s connector is plugged into your vehicle, Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist automatically turns off. In this case, you cannot get help Rear Cross-Traffic Collision-Avoidance Assist. Pay extra attention when you drive when the function is inactive. (If a Kia genuine Trailer Kit that can determine whether a trailer is connected is used)
You can check it in the service message of the utility information view of the cluster display window.
